title: test.quarantined payload v1
description: A test that flaked (test.flaked) enters quarantine owned by its unit's owner, who owes a stabilizing PR. The test stays blocking in every tier (D-025, D-065 V7). Repository channel: pr is null and sha is the commit it flaked on.

test.description: Test id as the gate reports it: the failing test file, else the failed stage.

owner.description: Owner of the test's unit (units/<id>/unit.json), or quarantine.unknown_owner when no manifest covers it.

flaked_event.description: event_id of the test.flaked that is the evidence.
